headers.positive_eigenvector_pair:
theorem positive_eigenvector_pair {r : ℕ} (X Y : Square r) (lam : ℝ)
    (hlam : 0 < lam) (hY : Y ≠ 0) (heig : commutatorT X Y = (lam : ℂ) • Y) :
    commutatorJ X Y ≠ 0 ∧
    commutatorT X (commutatorJ X Y) = (lam : ℂ) • commutatorJ X Y ∧
    hsInner Y (commutatorJ X Y) = 0 ∧
    frobeniusNorm (commutatorJ X Y) ^ 2 = lam * frobeniusNorm Y ^ 2 := by
headers.eigenspace_functional_kernel:
theorem eigenspace_functional_kernel {r : ℕ} (X Y : Square r) (lam : ℝ)
    (hlam : 0 < lam) (hY : Y ≠ 0) (heig : commutatorT X Y = (lam : ℂ) • Y)
    (f : Square r →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ) :
    ∃ Z : Square r, Z ≠ 0 ∧ commutatorT X Z = (lam : ℂ) • Z ∧ f Z = 0 := by

route: The exact adjoint energy identity gives the positive eigenvalue norm equality. J preserves this eigenspace and supplies a nonzero orthogonal partner. A linear combination of that pair cancels any functional, with nonzero proved from the orthogonality identity. No new numeric computation.
